why: Two seats of ours harass each other (sweep-casts-what-its-spawns-land's self-play start). A sweep casts the cheapest harasser that out-reaches a room's armed bodies, one a room within its spawns' share: no sweep asks more than one body at once (`askedMost`). On d561ef96, before, alpha's sweeps asked several at once on every seed 1-5 (beta on 4). Bodies lost are the engine's kills of every body a seat's engagements drew, held or released, bounded at seed 1's (alpha 53, beta 36): most are free bodies of closed engagements killed where they rest (alpha 36 of 42 deaths not held), an open defect, and the bounds come down with its fix. Sweep cost is a guardrail about 30% over the seed maxima, 46,780 energy. Across harmless plan perturbations of seed 1 (builder scan reversed, pathfinder heap order, wall road cost, every combination, on main and the centre-first planner) bodies lost reached 60 alpha and 71 beta on the count before, which missed a close's last tick's dead; the perturbations are not yet read on the engine's count. No bound on his economy bodies dying beside beta's sweeps: that count measured kills by Defend bodies the sweeps absorbed, and once a sweep takes in only harasser-shaped bodies it fell (28 -> 10 here), and over 16 paired self-play seeds the rival's economy bodies killed fell too (24.3 -> 18.4 a seed, 95% interval -9.9..-2.4) while the rival's harvest showed no measurable change (+0.7%, 95% interval -19k..+63k of 2.8M dug); a harassment guard should read the harvest it denies.
